annotations.title: Generate SBA Mentor-Protégé (13 CFR 125.9) & Joint Venture Operating Agreement

description: Audit and generate SBA All-Small Mentor-Protégé Program Agreements (13 CFR 125.9) and unpopulated Joint Venture Operating Agreements (13 CFR 125.8, 121.103(h), 124.513 8(a), 126.616 HUBZone, 127.506 WOSB, 128.402 SDVOSB), returning an SBA affiliation safe-harbor overview, all mandatory 13 CFR 125.8(b)(2) Operating Agreement clauses (Protégé Managing Venturer & Responsible Manager controls neutralizing OHA negative-control protests, >= 40% substantive Protégé workshare, commensurate profit distribution, dual-signature JV bank account, and equipment/labor schedules), a quantitative 40% Protégé workshare and FAR 52.219-14 audit, and a 6-year SBA MPP Developmental Plan blueprint. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive GovCon corporate structuring and SBA compliance generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `mentor_and_protege_profile_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `target_set_aside_and_jv_type` and `agreement_deliverable_scope` calibrate SBA socio-economic JV rules and developmental assistance plans). Use this tool when drafting or auditing an SBA 13 CFR 125.8 Joint Venture Operating Agreement or 13 CFR 125.9 Mentor-Protégé Developmental Plan to survive OHA size/status protests; use `generate_teaming_strategy` instead for standard FAR Subpart 9.6 Prime/Subcontractor Teaming Agreements, or `generate_small_business_participation` for Large Business Prime FAR 52.219-9 Subcontracting Plans.

agreement_deliverable_scope.description: Deliverable scope: 13 CFR 125.8(b)(2) Joint Venture Operating Agreement + Solicitation Addendum Clauses, 13 CFR 125.9 SBA Mentor-Protégé Developmental Plan, and OHA Size/Status Protest Pre-Audit (defaults to 'Full_13_CFR_125_8_JV_Operating_Agreement_Clauses_Plus_13_CFR_125_9_MPP_Developmental_Plan').

mentor_and_protege_profile_text.description: Profiles of the Protégé (Managing Venturer) and Mentor (Partner Venturer), socioeconomic certifications (Small, 8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone), target solicitation details, and proposed workshare split (20 to 45,000 characters).

target_set_aside_and_jv_type.description: Target socioeconomic set-aside and SBA JV regulation (13 CFR 125.8 Small Business, 128.402 SDVOSB, 124.513 8(a), 127.506 WOSB, or 126.616 HUBZone; defaults to 'Unpopulated_SDVOSB_And_All_Small_MPP_Joint_Venture_13_CFR_125_8_And_128_402').

name: generate_mentor_protege_jv_agreement

forty_percent_workshare_and_limitations_.description: Quantitative audit of FAR 52.219-14 Limitations on Subcontracting and the mandatory >= 40% Protégé workshare rule.

mentor_protege_and_jv_overview.description: Executive overview of SBA regulatory compliance, unpopulated LLC structure, affiliation safe harbor, and 2-year rule.

sba_mpp_developmental_plan_blueprint.description: SBA All-Small Mentor-Protégé Program (13 CFR 125.9) developmental assistance blueprint and term compliance check.

thirteen_cfr_125_8_mandatory_clauses.description: Complete set of 13 CFR 125.8(b)(2) mandatory Joint Venture Operating Agreement clauses neutralizing OHA protest traps.
